description: This file defines an interface 'ConsoleConfigurationInterface' within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically for console command registration. It declares a method 'registerCommands' that accepts a Console object, intended for configuring console commands in derived implementations.

classes.name: ConsoleConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing classes to define the 'registerCommands' method for console command configuration.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: A method that takes a Console object as a parameter, intended for registering or configuring console commands.
